description: Generates an AI image from a prompt (or edits uploaded images). Returns links to the finished images. Spends credits: model price × numImages (see fattly_list_models); fails with an error if the balance is too low, and credits are refunded automatically when a generation fails. Prompts must be safe-for-work.

inputImageUrl.description: Optional single input image for editing / face-swap models — must be a fal URL. Get one by uploading a local photo with fattly_upload_image.

inputImageUrls.description: Optional MULTIPLE input images (fal URLs) for multi-image edit models like nano-banana-2-edit / nano-banana-pro-edit. Typical swap use: image #1 = the scene/frame to keep (background, framing, lighting), image #2 = the subject/face to place into that scene. Get each URL from fattly_upload_image.

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate.

name: fattly_generate_image
title: Generate an image
